messages:
Ajay Patel: Heads-up — HeliosNova POC escalated to C-suite. CISO pushed for SOC2 proof, EU data residency, + committed latency/throughput for inference. They also want firm pricing for Dedicated bundle vs Private deploy. Asking to escalate to execs.

Selena Ortiz: Ack. @Maria Chen can you confirm target qps and typical max seq length from the POC traces? Need that to size Dedicated.

Maria Chen: Raj (Helios) sent logs — peak 240 qps, mostly seq 512 with spikes to 1024. Avg 45 qps. I attached a sanitized sample to the ticket.

Samir Rao: From infra POV, EU region capacity available but Dedicated autoscale will need reserve baseline of 4 A100s to hit <80ms p99 for seq512 under peak; with batching.

Ajay Patel: OK — CISO is specifically asking whether we can guarantee <100ms p99 for production and a monthly committed SLA. Also wants price delta for Private on-prem vs Dedicated in EU.

Selena Ortiz: I'll assemble two price options. Quick calc: Dedicated (reserved): baseline 4 gpus + burst 2 -> monthly commit estimate. Private on-prem = platform license + infra.

Maria Chen: Sharing quick perf notes: with current model quantized and prefix caching, p99 ~75ms at 240 qps on 4xA100 if we do continuous batching and prefix cache hit >60%. If no cache, p99 jumps to ~160ms.

Samir Rao: Important: KV cache persistence in Private requires KMS integration; Legal Ops flagged key custody. @Legal Ops Bot can you outline required artifacts?

Legal Ops Bot: Required artifacts: SOC2 Type II report, data processing addendum (DPA), encryption at rest proof (KMS/HSM), network topology diagram, and SLAs. Lead legal contact: legal@redwood.ai.

Ajay Patel: Thanks. CISO also has a vendor questionnaire — ~30 Qs. Can Legal prioritize answers for SOC/compliance + egress? They want responses by EOD tomorrow or they escalate to procurement hold.

Kira Lo (CEO): I can join the call if procurement pushes hold. Recommend we put an exec-level note on price flexibility and commit to a 3mo pilot discount contingent on passing SOC2/DPA sign-off.

Selena Ortiz: Draft pricing snapshot for review:
```
Option A (Dedicated reserved): $86,000/mo commit (4xA100 baseline) + $12k/mo burst buffer
Option B (Private - managed): $150,000 platform + infra ops TBD + one-time onboarding $40k
Notes: pilot discount available for first 3 months (20%).
```

Ajay Patel: Good. @Samir can you validate the infra-side numbers and any hidden network costs (peering, egress)?

Samir Rao: Validating. Early flags: cross-region egress for backups to US will add ~5-12% on bandwidth. Private on-prem will need a separate support SLA (onsite windows).

Maria Chen: For the technical POC timeline: if we sign DPA by Fri, we can provision Dedicated staging cluster in 3 business days and enable telemetry for p99 tests.

Selena Ortiz: Action items: 1) Legal to push questionnaire answers (Legal Ops Bot assigned) 2) Infra to confirm final pricing delta and egress calc (Samir) 3) Engineering to prepare perf runbook & traces (Maria) 4) Exec note & call if procurement stalls (Kira)

Ajay Patel: Assigning owners accordingly. Goal: respond to customer with detailed compliance answers + pricing + proposed pilot terms within 24 hours. If procurement holds, Kira to join escalation bridge.

Ops-Bot: :rotating_light: Meeting scheduled by Ajay Patel: HeliosNova escalation bridge — Thu 15:00 UTC. Dial-in: zoom.us/j/xxxxx.

Selena Ortiz: Added supporting slides and a concise one-pager for the CISO — will drop into the thread shortly. :white_check_mark: 

Maria Chen: I uploaded the sanitized trace and perf matrix to the ticket.

Ajay Patel: Great, thanks everyone. Will ping Helios execs after we have Legal answers + validated infra numbers.

Kira Lo (CEO): Keep me posted. If they indicate lock-in risk, we should offer a 3-month commitment with buyout clause.

Ajay Patel: Noted. Last_message: documenting next steps and owners.
